summary.headline: Luminary Conjunctions by Triplicity
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of conjunctions of the two luminaries in the earthy and airy triplicities, with separate effects for Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn, Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius. Predictions concern weather, crops, diseases, rulers and subjects, scribes, merchants, travelers, prices, correspondence, rebellion, and the flooding of the Nile.
